answer: Split-puzzle bandwidth audits: each epoch the network pairs random keys and hands each one half of a puzzle that can't be solved without the other half's details. All talk between partners must pass through a metered relay harbor that counts the bits sent. Honest strangers have to spell out their half, so the relay sees a steady pulse of messages. Two keys run by one operator already share memory, so they finish after a mere whisper. Pairs that keep solving below that information floor are merged into one reward slot.
